note: Phase 2-A external observations collected by the CDP measurement driver (not by the page). Scopes: workerHeap = CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage on the auto-attached benchmark Worker target (that Worker isolate JS heap, sampled about every 2 s, includes not-yet-collected garbage); os = Windows process memory of the Chrome renderer processes of the measurement profile (PrivateMemorySize64 / WorkingSet64 / PeakWorkingSet64, sampled about every 5 s; PeakWorkingSet64 is the process-lifetime peak, so it can include earlier runs in the same renderer). atMs = driver ms since the task started (not Worker-local).
